Cat Pirates Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 23, 2026

You play without creating an account, and your progress is saved on your device. If you are signed in to Google Play Games, your achievements and leaderboard scores are stored by Google. TeamCP runs no server that receives your game records, and the game has no in-app purchases. The ad services (Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads) process device information and advertising identifiers needed to deliver ads; on first launch we ask about personalized ads and do not start the ad SDK until you choose. A problem report is sent to TeamCP's report server only when you send one yourself from Settings.

Applies to version 1.0.0. We update this page and its date when features or ad setup change.

1. Scope and operator

TeamCP develops and operates the Android game “Cat Pirates: Midnight Snack Heist” (냥냥 해적단: 야식 대작전, com.teamcp.catpirates). This policy explains what information the game handles and the choices you have. Contact: teamcp.channel@gmail.com.

The game has no account sign-up of its own, no server that receives your game records, no chat and no in-app purchases. The only sign-in is Google Play Games. We do not request or collect your name, email, phone number, location (GPS), contacts, microphone or camera, and the app does not access your device photos or gallery (the in-game “photo album” is a collection of in-game pictures). The permissions the app itself uses are internet and network state (ads, Play Games and problem reports), vibration (effects) and the advertising ID (AD_ID). The Android ad services attribution and topics APIs and the WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE permissions come from the ad SDK libraries. If you contact support by email, we use your address and message only to reply.

2. Information stored on your device

This information is kept in the app's private Android storage (the app database and settings file) for game features such as continuing and collections. Game progress and settings are never sent to TeamCP servers. There is no cloud save. The app contains no analytics (such as Firebase Analytics) and no automatic crash reporting. A problem report is sent only when you send it yourself (section 7).

  • Game progress: the in-game day and current stage, snack count, cleared and attempted stages, scouted obstacles, tutorial progress, Endless Night records, total heists and successes, and the in-game day you last opened the gift box
  • Cats: which cats have joined, level and experience, mood, fatigue, fullness and bond, unavailable status and number of heists
  • Collections and logs: snack collection, photo album, event history and scheduled events
  • Settings: sound effects, music, fast night playback, personalized-ads choice
  • Unsent problem reports: a report you sent is kept on the device (up to 50) until the server accepts it, then sent again

3. Google Play Games

When the app starts it tries to sign in automatically with the Google Play Games account set up on your device. If you are not signed in or sign-in fails, you can still play the whole game; only achievements and leaderboard scores are not recorded.

While you are signed in, Google Play Games (Google LLC) processes the following:

  • Your Play Games player ID, gamer nickname and profile image (your Google account email is not shared with the game)
  • Unlocks of the game's 18 achievements
  • Leaderboard scores for “Endless Night best” and “Total successful heists” — leaderboard scores and nicknames may be visible to other players

Your game progress is not uploaded to Google (no cloud save). TeamCP does not keep this data on its own servers and only sees aggregated achievement and leaderboard statistics in Play Console. Google's Privacy Policy and the Google Play Games Services terms apply to this processing.

4. Android Auto Backup

This app allows Android Auto Backup and device-to-device transfer. If backup is on, Android encrypts the game saves and settings above into your Google Account backup and can restore them when you reinstall or move to a new device.

This backup is a Google feature controlled by your device settings; TeamCP cannot access it. You can turn it off or delete it in Settings > Google > Backup.

5. Ads and the information ad services process

The game is free and supported by ads, served through Unity LevelPlay (mediation) and Unity Ads. It does not include AdMob, Firebase or payment SDKs.

Ads are rewarded ads that play only when you tap them (retrying a failed night and doubling a successful night's reward, each once per night; the gift box once per in-game day), and interstitials shown only when you move on to the next day and at least 4 minutes apart. Interstitials are never shown during the tutorial (stages 1–5) or right after a rewarded ad. There is one banner slot at the bottom of the screen: after you make your consent choice, a small banner ad may be shown there when one is available. When there is no banner ad, a TeamCP house banner appears in the same place, and it opens the TeamCP website in your browser only when you tap it. You can clear every stage and reach the ending without watching rewarded or interstitial ads.

To load and show ads, the ad services may process:

  • IP address and approximate region derived from it; device model, OS, app version, language and network information
  • Android advertising ID, app set ID and other ad/SDK identifiers
  • Ad request, impression, click and completion events, plus error and diagnostic data

These are used to deliver ads, manage frequency, measure performance, prevent fraud and diagnose problems. The app is marked as “not directed to children” with the ad services. TeamCP does not receive individual user data from the ad services; we only see aggregated revenue and impression statistics in their dashboards.

6. Your ad choices

Your choice is stored only on your device and passed to the mediation service (Unity LevelPlay) as a consent signal. If you decline, a "do not sell or share" signal under certain U.S. state laws is sent as well.

  • Every player is asked on first launch whether to allow personalized ads, and the ad SDK does not start until you choose. If you decline, you see the same number of ads but they are not personalized, and the whole game remains playable.
  • You can change this anytime under Settings > "맞춤형 광고" (Personalized ads); the new choice applies from the next launch.
  • In Android Settings > Privacy > Ads you can reset or delete your advertising ID. Once deleted, a zeroed value is sent instead and cannot be used for personalized ads.
  • Use the privacy icon inside an ad or the Unity policy below to access, delete or opt out of ad data.
  • With the internet turned off no ad requests are made, and the game can still be played offline (only rewarded-ad bonuses are unavailable).

7. Problem reports

A report is sent only when you write a description under Settings > “Report a problem” and tap Send. Nothing is reported automatically and there is no crash reporting. A report contains:

  • The description you wrote (up to 2,000 characters) and the report type you chose
  • Attached automatically: app name and version, the name of the screen you reported from, app language, device model name, and a random report number created for each report

Reports do not include your advertising ID, any account, Google Play Games information, your game progress or your location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the description. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on the report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to investigate and fix problems or answer questions. The server and hosting provider may process your IP address as a connection log while the report is sent. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from receipt and then deleted, or deleted right away if you ask before then.

If you are offline or sending fails, the report is kept on the device (up to 50) and sent again while the game is open. Reports waiting on the device are not included in Android backups and are erased when you clear the app's data.

8. Third-party services and international processing

Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads, Google Play Games and Android (Google) services are governed by their own policies. Ad information, Play Games data and backup data may be processed outside your country; see each provider's policy for recipients, locations and safeguards. Problem reports are stored on a hosting server in the Republic of Korea.

TeamCP does not sell your information. However, some laws may treat data processing in the advertising ecosystem as a “sale” or “sharing”, so please also review the opt-out and rights information from the providers below.

Detailed notice of overseas transfers (added November 23, 2026)

Under Articles 28-8 and 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), we list each kind of processing in this game in which personal information is transferred outside Korea. The information below is sent directly from your device to each provider without passing through any server operated by TeamCP. Provider details are based on each provider’s published policy.

Ads — Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads, ironSource Ads

Recipient and contact
Unity Technologies (Unity Technologies S.F.) — operator of Unity LevelPlay, Unity Ads and ironSource Ads
Contact: DPO@unity3d.com · 116 New Montgomery Street, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105, United States
Destination countries
The United States, plus countries where Unity has facilities (including Israel, where ironSource is headquartered) and countries with data centers of service providers Unity uses (such as Google Cloud Platform) — as stated in Unity’s Game Player and App User Privacy Policy
Data transferred
Advertising identifiers (Google advertising ID, app set ID, etc., to the extent device settings allow), IP address and approximate location derived from it, device model, operating system, app version, language, network information, and ad request, impression, click, completed-view, error and diagnostic information (details in the ads section of this policy)
When and how
Each time the ad SDK initializes or requests, shows or measures an ad while the app is running, sent directly from your device to Unity’s servers over the internet (encrypted connection)
Purpose
Ad mediation and delivery, frequency capping, performance measurement, fraud prevention, error diagnosis
Retention period
Unity states that it keeps data for as long as needed for the processing purposes and may keep it longer when needed for legal obligations or for disputes or investigations (Unity policy section 10, “Retention”). Because Unity does not publish a fixed retention period for general ad data, this policy does not state a separate period.
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to perform the contract for providing a free (ad-supported) game, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy
How to refuse and effect
If you turn off the internet connection, no ad requests or transfers take place. If you delete the advertising ID in Android settings, the advertising ID is not sent. If you do not want any transfer, you can stop using and uninstall the app; in that case you cannot use ads or ad rewards. To access or delete information already transferred, contact Unity (DPO@unity3d.com) or use the privacy icon in the ad.

Google — Google Play Games · Android Auto Backup

Recipient and contact
Google LLC
Contact: googlekrsupport@google.com · Domestic representative in Korea: Google Korea LLC (22F, 152 Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul · +82-2-722-7778 · data-access-requests@google.com) — as stated in Google’s “Additional privacy information for Korean residents”
Destination countries
Google data centers outside Korea (such as the United States). See Google data center locations for where they are.
Data transferred
Google Play Games: Play Games player ID, gamer nickname and profile image, achievement records, leaderboard scores (Endless Night best record and total successful missions)
Android Auto Backup: if backup is on in your device settings, Android sends this app’s saved data and settings to your Google account’s backup storage (nothing is sent if you turn it off in device settings).
When and how
Sent to Google over the network (encrypted connection) at the same time the information is collected, when the feature is used (per Google)
Purpose
Sign-in and Play Games features such as achievements and leaderboards, Device backup and restore
Retention period
Google account and Play Games data are kept until you delete them or for the period Google sets (“Retaining your information” in Google’s Privacy Policy).
Legal basis
PIPA Article 28-8(1)(iii)(a) — treated as outsourcing and storage needed to provide the game-linked features you choose, with the transfer details disclosed in this policy · Android Auto Backup depends on your device and Google account backup settings
How to refuse and effect
Nothing is sent if you do not sign in to Play Games, and you can use the whole game. In that case no achievements or leaderboard records are kept. You can turn off or delete backups under Android Settings > Google > Backup; in that case data is not restored automatically when you reinstall or change devices.

The following processing takes place in Korea and is not an overseas transfer.

  • Problem reports: reports you send yourself are stored on the report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea) and are not transferred abroad.

9. Deleting data and retention

Game data on your device remains until you delete it. Problem reports sent to the server are deleted 90 days after they are received. Retention of Play Games, backup and ad information follows each provider's policy. We keep support emails no longer than needed after replying.

  • In the game: Settings > Start over (처음부터 다시 하기) erases the progress, cats, collections and event history on this device. This cannot be undone. It does not remove Google Play Games achievements or leaderboard scores.
  • On the device: uninstall the app, or use Android Settings > Apps > 냥냥 해적단 (Cat Pirates) > Storage > Clear data to erase all game data including settings and unsent reports. Game progress is not kept on any TeamCP server.
  • Reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and, if possible, part of the text), and we will find and delete it.
  • Google Play Games: you can remove achievement and leaderboard records and your Play Games profile by deleting the game data or profile in the Google Play Games app (or Play Store) settings.
  • Android backup: turn off or delete backups under Settings > Google > Backup.
  • Ad information: delete or reset your advertising ID and use the request process in Unity's policy. Uninstalling the app does not erase information ad providers have already processed.
  • Need help? Email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the app name and your request. Never send passwords or ID documents. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will point you to the right provider's process.

10. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to processing, withdraw consent, opt out of sale/sharing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Because TeamCP keeps no game data on its own servers, most requests are handled with the in-game delete option, device settings, Google Play Games or the ad providers; requests about problem reports are handled by TeamCP directly. We will tell you which route to use.

11. Children and parents

Cat Pirates is a stealth-puzzle and management game about caring for cats and planning nightly snack heists, and it is not directed to children under 13. The app is marked “not directed to children” with the ad services and has no age check or parental-consent feature.

If you believe a child under 13 has had information processed, contact us and we will explain how to delete it.

12. Security and changes

Game data is kept in the app’s private Android storage, which other apps cannot read. Ad traffic, Play Games and backups use each provider’s encrypted connections. Problem reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS).

When features, SDKs or processing change, we update this policy and its date and announce important changes on this page. The game’s screens are in Korean; if the Korean and English versions of this policy seem to differ, please contact us.

Additional notice under Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (added November 23, 2026)

Under Article 30 of Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and Article 31 of its Enforcement Decree, this notice explains your rights and how to exercise them, children under 14 and their legal guardians, the security measures we take, and our privacy officer. It applies together with the rest of this policy.

Your rights and how to exercise them

  • You may at any time ask TeamCP to give you access to, correct, delete, or suspend the processing of the personal information it processes about you, and you may withdraw your consent (PIPA Articles 35–37).
  • How to ask: email the app name and your request to the contact below (teamcp.channel@gmail.com). Because the app has no accounts, please include information that lets TeamCP find the record (for example, the approximate date or report number of a problem report). A legal guardian or a person you authorize may also make a request; in that case we may ask for proof of that relationship.
  • Response time: we will tell you the outcome within 10 days of receiving your request. If the law gives a reason to limit or refuse the request, or we cannot complete it within that time, we will tell you why and how to object.
  • Information stored only on your device (app records, settings, and so on) is not held by TeamCP, so you can delete it yourself with the app’s delete options, by clearing the app’s storage in Android settings, or by uninstalling the app.
  • For information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google, you can also contact each provider at the contact listed in the overseas transfer notice above.
  • Remedies in Korea: you can apply for dispute mediation or advice to the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (+82-1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr), the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (118, privacy.kisa.or.kr), the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office (1301, www.spo.go.kr), or the Korean National Police Agency (182, ecrm.police.go.kr).

Children under 14 and legal guardians

  • Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act requires the consent of a legal guardian when the personal information of a child under 14 is processed on the basis of consent (Article 22-2).
  • This app does not ask for a date of birth or age, and it has no age check or way to confirm a guardian’s consent. Because it does not treat users differently by age, the processing described in this policy also applies to users under 14. The app tells the ad services, at app level, that it is “not directed to children”. This is not the result of checking any individual user’s age.
  • Personalized ads: on first launch the app asks whether to allow personalized ads and does not start the ad SDK until you choose. Users under 14 should not allow personalized ads and should choose the non-personalized option. If personalized ads were already allowed, you can change this in the app settings.
  • Users under 14 should not include personal information such as their name or contact details in problem reports or inquiries.
  • Guardians’ rights and how to exercise them: a legal guardian may ask for access to, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of the child’s personal information, and may withdraw consent. The method and response time are the same as in “Your rights and how to exercise them” above. We ask only for the minimum information needed to confirm guardianship and delete it once confirmed.
  • If we learn that the personal information of a child under 14 has been processed without a legal guardian’s consent, we will promptly delete that information held by TeamCP.

Security measures for personal information

  • On-device storage: app records and settings are stored in the app-private storage that Android keeps separate for each app, and are not sent to servers operated by TeamCP except as described in this policy.
  • Encrypted transmission: information the app sends over the internet (ad requests, Google services, problem reports) is sent over encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS).
  • Report server access limits: the problem-report server accepts only reports in a fixed format sent by registered apps, and stores app authentication values as hashes, not as the original values. Administrative access to the server and database is limited to TeamCP’s operator account. Reports do not automatically include the advertising ID, account, or location.
  • Data minimization: we do not collect sign-ups, passwords, names, or phone numbers, which keeps the personal information held by TeamCP to a minimum.
  • Retention and deletion: problem reports are deleted 90 days after receipt, or earlier if you ask us to delete them.
  • Inquiry emails are deleted once they are no longer needed after we have responded. Personal information is kept only as electronic files and is deleted when the retention period ends.
  • Security for information processed by outside providers such as the ad services and Google follows each provider’s policy.
